summary: High-Trend International Group announced on Form 6-K the cancellation and retirement of 630,000 Class A ordinary shares previously issued to Streeterville Capital under an October 2025 securities purchase agreement. The shares were returned after a payoff and termination agreement satisfied all obligations. The cancellation reduces issued and outstanding Class A shares by 630,000, improving the capital structure and reducing dilution. No price, premium, or valuation was disclosed. Chairman Christopher Nixon Cox highlighted the optimization of flexibility. This is a capital-return event via share retirement. No advisor named; the regulatory clock is immediate. Watch for potential further capital-management actions or dilution reduction.
